蒸发 → 输送 → 降水 → 下渗与径流: Evaporation → transport → precipitation → infiltration and runoff

山丘、密林、湖、河与沙滩：降水在这里分成蒸散、下渗与地表径流: Hills, forest, lake, river and beach: here precipitation splits into evapotranspiration, infiltration and surface runoff
两团云与水汽带：水汽被气流从海洋上空送到陆地上空: Two clouds and a vapor band: air currents carry water vapor from over the ocean to over the land

下渗的水在含水层里以地下径流回到海洋: Infiltrated water returns to the ocean as groundwater flow in the aquifer
同一块地：一层砾石把下渗推上去、把土面蒸发压下来: The same plot: a gravel layer pushes infiltration up and holds soil evaporation down
看 8 s：海面与湖面的水汽 → 天上那束水汽带 → 两团云 → 两处雨丝 →: Watch for 8 s: vapor from the sea and lake → the vapor band in the sky → two clouds → two areas of rain → river channel and underground flow, lighting up layer by layer

教材给的半个答案：太阳加热海水使海水蒸发，河流注入大海补充蒸发的消耗，海水既不会: The textbook's half-answer: the sun heats sea water and it evaporates, rivers flow into the sea to make up for evaporation, and the sea neither grows nor shrinks (p.46).
完整的账在这里：海洋每年蒸发 1100 mm（示意），其中约 110 mm 的海: The full account is here: the ocean evaporates 1100 mm a year (schematic), of which about 110 mm ocean-equivalent comes back via rivers and 990 mm falls directly on the sea, so the budget balances.
蒸发的海水没有消失——它去了陆地上空，又顺着河流回来；世界里五个环节各占一处，指: Evaporated sea water doesn't vanish; it goes to the sky over land and comes back down the rivers; each of the five links has its own place in the scene and can be pointed to.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「水循环有五个环节」，答不出导入那句「为什么大海的水没有增: Skip this step and students only recite "the water cycle has five links" and can't answer the opening question "why doesn't the sea get fuller".
常考：海水水量稳定的原因是蒸发与降水、径流的收支相抵，不是「河流水量太少」。: Often tested: sea volume is stable because evaporation balances precipitation and runoff, not because "rivers carry too little water".
大海的水没有增多，是因为支出的蒸发与收入的降水、河流回水正好相抵——蒸发的海水去: The sea doesn't get fuller because the outflow by evaporation exactly balances the inflow by precipitation and river return; evaporated sea water goes to the sky over land and returns to the ocean as runoff.

水汽从水面（和土面、植物）蒸发出来，动力是太阳辐射（教材「在太阳辐射作用下大量蒸: Water vapor evaporates from water surfaces (and soil and plants), driven by solar radiation (textbook: "evaporates in large amounts under solar radiation").

太阳辐射越强，海面蒸发越强；蒸发量一变，下游的输送、降水、径流全都跟着变。: The stronger the solar radiation, the more the sea evaporates; when evaporation changes, transport, precipitation and runoff downstream all follow.

陆地上的水汽既来自地面、水面蒸发，也来自植物蒸腾；植被越密，蒸腾占比越大、下渗也: Water vapor on land comes both from evaporation off ground and water surfaces and from plant transpiration; the denser the vegetation, the larger the share of transpiration and the more infiltration.

水汽被气流输送到大陆上空（教材 p.46「水汽上升到空中，被气流输送到大陆上空」: Water vapor is carried by air currents to over the continent (textbook p.46 "water vapor rises into the air and is carried by air currents to over the continent").

海洋的水是「借」给陆地的，借多少由输送决定——第 6 步要用这条线索解释大循环。: The ocean's water is "lent" to the land, and how much is set by transport; step 6 uses this thread to explain the major cycle.
去掉这一步：学生以为陆地降水是「本地自己下的雨」，说不清海洋对陆地水资源的意义。: Skip this step and students think rain on land is "local rain falling by itself" and can't explain what the ocean means for water resources on land.

海洋的水汽被气流送到陆地上空，输送越强，陆地得到的降水越多、海上直接降落的越少。: Ocean water vapor is carried over land by air currents; the stronger the transport, the more rain the land gets and the less falls directly on the sea.

点一下剖面上的含水层：降水被分成蒸散、下渗、地表径流三路的读数一起亮起来: Click the aquifer in the cross-section: the readings for precipitation split three ways (evapotranspiration, infiltration, surface runoff) light up together
陆地降水 759 = 蒸散 490 + 下渗 110 + 地表径流 159（mm: Land precipitation 759 = evapotranspiration 490 + infiltration 110 + surface runoff 159 (mm/a, schematic); infiltration ratio 0.41, groundwater flow 110, equal to infiltration
图 3.2 的下渗 ×2 与地下径流: Infiltration ×2 and groundwater flow in Fig. 3.2
降落到地面的水或被蒸发（蒸腾），或沿地面流动形成地表径流，或渗入地下形成地下径流: Water falling on the ground either evaporates (or transpires), flows over the surface as surface runoff, or soaks in to become groundwater flow (textbook p.47).
陆地降水 759 = 蒸散 490 + 下渗 110 + 地表径流 159；下渗: Land precipitation 759 = evapotranspiration 490 + infiltration 110 + surface runoff 159; infiltrated water returns to the ocean as groundwater flow of 110.
下渗不是「漏掉」，是另一条回海的路——剖面里两支箭头的终点接得上。: Infiltration isn't "leaking away"; it's another road back to the sea; the ends of the two arrows in the cross-section connect.
去掉这一步：学生以为下渗的水「就没了」，也说不出河流的水量从哪几部分来。: Skip this step and students think infiltrated water "is just gone", and can't say which parts make up a river's flow.
易错：下渗的水不会消失，它以地下径流的形式汇入江河或直接入海。: Common mistake: infiltrated water doesn't vanish; it joins rivers or flows directly to the sea as groundwater flow.
落到地面的水一部分蒸发蒸腾、一部分成为地表径流、一部分下渗成地下径流，后两者最后: Of the water falling on the ground, some evaporates or transpires, some becomes surface runoff, and some infiltrates to become groundwater flow; the last two both end up back in the ocean.

三类循环，各走哪一条路？: Three types of cycle: which path does each take?
把「循环类型」拨到「海陆间」，再依次拨到「陆地内」「海上内」：看图上只剩这一类的: Switch "Cycle type" to "sea–land", then to "inland" and "ocean": the diagram shows only that type's path
海陆间：陆地降水 269、径流 269、陆地蒸散 0；陆地内：陆地降水 490、: Sea–land: land precipitation 269, runoff 269, land evapotranspiration 0; inland: land precipitation 490, runoff to sea 0; ocean: land precipitation 0 (mm/a, schematic)
关掉海陆间：陆地仍下雨，径流入海 0（示意）: Sea–land cycle off: it still rains on land, runoff to sea 0 (schematic)
大循环使陆地水得到补充: The major cycle replenishes water on land
三类循环按发生的空间范围分：海陆间循环（大循环）、陆地内循环、海上内循环（教材: The three types of cycle are classified by spatial extent: the sea–land cycle (major cycle), the inland cycle and the ocean cycle (textbook p.46).
拨档看：陆地内档里陆地仍下雨（490）但径流入海为 0；海上内档里陆地降水为 0: Switch through them: in the inland setting it still rains on land (490) but runoff to sea is 0; in the ocean setting land precipitation is 0; in the sea–land setting all land precipitation comes from ocean transport.
大循环使陆地上的水不断得到补充、水资源得以再生（p.46）——这正是本课主线问题: The major cycle keeps replenishing water on land so water resources are renewed (p.46); that's the answer to this lesson's main question.
去掉这一步：学生只记住「水循环」一个笼统的词，分不清三类，也回答不了「关掉海陆间: Skip this step and students only remember the vague term "water cycle", can't distinguish the three types, and can't answer "what happens to land if the sea–land cycle stops".
常考：三类循环的区分标准是空间范围；使陆地水资源得以再生的是海陆间循环（大循环）: Often tested: the three types are distinguished by spatial extent; the sea–land cycle (major cycle) is what renews water resources on land.
海陆间循环把海洋的水送到陆地、再经江河送回海洋，使陆地水不断得到补充；陆地内循环: The sea–land cycle sends ocean water to land and back to the ocean through rivers, constantly replenishing water on land; the inland cycle has only local evapotranspiration and precipitation; the ocean cycle is completed entirely over the sea.

把「地表覆盖」拨到砂田：砾石层铺上去，看这块田的下渗变大、土面蒸发变小、地表径流: Switch "Ground cover" to gravel field: with the gravel layer down, watch this plot's infiltration rise and its soil evaporation and surface runoff fall

改的是蒸发与下渗两个环节: It changes two links: evaporation and infiltration

砂田是耕作土面上铺 10—15 厘米砂石覆盖层，作物成行种在砾石里（教材 p.4: A gravel field has a 10–15 cm layer of sand and gravel laid over the tilled soil, with crops planted in rows in the gravel (textbook p.48 activity, Fig. 3.3).

改的是「蒸发」与「下渗」两个环节——省下的土面蒸发留在土里，所以地表径流也更少；: It changes the "evaporation" and "infiltration" links: the soil evaporation saved stays in the soil, so surface runoff is also lower; global readings such as land precipitation 759 and runoff to sea 269 don't change, since one field's measures don't change the global budget.

砂石覆盖层让这块田的下渗更多、土面蒸发更少，于是同一份降水里更多留在土里、更少流: The gravel layer gives this plot more infiltration and less soil evaporation, so more of the same rainfall stays in the soil and less runs off; it changes the evaporation and infiltration links, while the precipitation itself doesn't change.

为什么说水资源「有限」？: Why are water resources said to be "limited"?
把「水体」逐档拖过去：江河 16 天 → 湖泊 17 年 → 深层地下水 140: Drag through "Water body" step by step: rivers 16 days → lakes 17 years → deep groundwater 1400 years → mountain glaciers 1600 years → polar ice 9700 years → ocean 2500 years

更新周期差上千倍: Renewal periods differ by thousands of times
径流还搬泥沙、塑造地表: Runoff also carries sediment and shapes the land
水循环使地球上各种水体处于不断更新状态，从而维持全球水量的动态平衡（教材 p.4: The water cycle keeps Earth's water bodies constantly renewing, maintaining the dynamic balance of global water (textbook p.48).
